THIS ZONE FILE POINTS AT FOOTAGE THAT IS NOT COMMITTED. testdata/youtube2/eO19UTm93GQ.mp4 is deliberately gitignored: it is video pulled off somebody else's site and nobody has been asked, so it is not republished here.
It is kept because the line was MEASURED against that footage — the line is inside the band the detector actually saw the traffic occupy, which is why it works. A line measured against material you no longer have is worse than no line at all.
The committed demo runs testdata/car-crossing.mp4 with testdata/car-crossing.zones.json, and both of those ARE in git.
The zone for the highway footage, PLACED FROM MEASUREMENT, not guessed.
Measured by running the real model over four frames of this footage at 00:00:04,
00:00:10, 00:00:16 and 00:00:22. Each frame yielded 21-32 vehicles with confidence
0.81-0.96, and their box centres ran from y=0.19 to y=0.83 of the frame height.
A horizontal line at y=0.50 therefore sits inside the band the traffic occupies, and
is crossed by vehicles in BOTH directions: the near carriageway runs toward the
camera (top to bottom) and the far one away from it (bottom to top). The engine calls
those two directions apart, so one line produces events that are not duplicates of
provenance: real. Every number the report derives from this footage is labelled real.
note: The line is at the middle of the band the measured traffic occupies. A line placed by eye on a single frame would be a guess, and a wrong line produces zero events and no error.
